%
% The author block below is NOT rendered while the package is used without an
% option; tmlr.sty hides it. Do not delete it, and do not add [accepted] or
% [preprint] before the paper is actually accepted: TMLR states that
% non-anonymous submissions are rejected without review.
%
% Must stay the FIRST line: tmlr.sty loads eso-pic, which loads xcolor, so
% without the early pass our \usepackage[table]{xcolor} option-clashes, the
% [table] option is silently dropped, \cellcolor is never defined, and every
% shaded table cell prints a literal "green!18". Same trap as the ICLR root.
\PassOptionsToPackage{table}{xcolor}

\documentclass[10pt]{article}
\usepackage{tmlr}
